chat.lockedDescription: Unlock the power of interactive AI revisions, automated outline restructuring, and code schema generations by upgrading to Premium.
chat.welcome:
Hi Developer! I am ready to help you revise the document **"{title}"**.

You can type change instructions in natural language, for example:
* *"add a new user story for admin"*
* *"clarify the response latency part in the non-functional requirements"*
* *"add an abandoned shopping cart reminder feature"*

chat.approved: (You have approved the changes and applied them to the document)
